plan: Reserve reset under the same work-gate mutex as all starts and updates, after matching one-shot preview confirmation; reject another reset, update or quit.

Keep a separate permanently closed maintenance-admission flag. If drain/marker fails or panics, release only quit dispatch, never restart already-stopped services or reopen work admission. Explicit normal quit can retry the idempotent drain.

Extract the existing complete blocking shutdown drain and use it for normal quit and factory reset: stop SOOP admission, detach official Pinterest surface, cancel Pinterest/Pixiv, shut down platform media, stop CHZZK, observe actual new-platform active counts until settled, then drain legacy analysis/download workers.

Commit the startup marker only after drain returns, using a same-directory create-new temporary file, full write/sync and no-clobber publication. A failed publication must not leave a partial marker or overwrite an existing marker.
Return a specific restart-required error on reset failure; do not report successful reset or force app exit. Preserve all original/final/chat media and existing recovery journals.
Coordinate lib.rs marker validation and SOOP reservation reset semantics with their owners; do not independently widen reset deletion scope.
conflicts: Reset confirmation authorizes app-state reset, not deleting media or unverified originals.

Keeping the quit flag forever after failure would make explicit normal quit a no-op; allow quit dispatch without allowing new work.
A timeout is not proof that workers are finished. Do not commit a reset marker or exit while active ownership remains.
